```yaml
name: Auto merge release into main

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 10 * * *' # 10:00 UTC (4am CST)
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  auto-merge:
    if: github.repository == 'jdx/mise'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install GitHub CLI
        run: npm install -g @github/cli

      - name: Authenticate with GitHub CLI
        run: echo "${{ secrets.GH_TOKEN }}" | gh auth login --with-token

      - name: Configure git
        run: |
          git config user.name "mise-en-dev"
          git config user.email "mise-en-dev@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Find open release to main PR
        id: find_pr
        run: |
          pr=$(gh pr list --head release --base main --state open --json number --jq '.[0].number')
          echo "pr=$pr" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Merge PR
        if: steps.find_pr.outputs.pr != ''
        run: |
          set -e
          if ! gh pr merge ${{ steps.find_pr.outputs.pr }} --merge --auto; then
            echo "Merge failed, skipping."
            exit 0
          fi
```
